arabic text: KOYI HUSAYN SA SAJDA BHALA ADAA TO KARE\n(YE RASHK JISPE, SADAA KHAKE KARBALA TO KARE)...
english translation text: Let anyone try to offer a prostration like Hussain’s—\na prostration envied forever by the dust of Karbala.

arabic text: SHAHEED KON SA GUZRA HAI PURE AALAM ME\nSINA KI NOK PE JO ZIKRE\nLA ILAAH TO KARE
english translation text: What other martyr in the whole world\nremembered ‘There is no god but God’\nfrom the point of a spear?

arabic text: LABE FURAT WO BAZU KATA KE SOYA HAI\nABBAS JESI JAHA ME\nKOI WAFAA TO KARE
english translation text: Beside the Euphrates he sleeps with both arms severed.\nLet anyone in the world show loyalty\nlike Abbas.

arabic text: ALAM KE NICHE JO MAANGO KABUL HOTI HAI\nKHULUS DIL SE KOI SHAKS\nAGAR DUWA TO KARE
english translation text: Whatever is asked beneath the standard is accepted,\nwhen a person prays\nwith a sincere heart.

arabic text: MAI BABA AAP KA BETA HU GO KE ASGHER HU\nKAHO LAEE(N) SE SITAM KI\nWO INTIHAA TO KARE
english translation text: ‘Father, I am your son, though I am only Asghar.\nTell the accursed enemy\nto reach the very limit of cruelty.’

arabic text: KAHA SE LAWONGE AYSA JIGAR JO DEEN KE LIYE\nASR SE PEHLE BAHATAR\nKO JO JUDAA TO KARE
english translation text: Where will you find a heart strong enough, for the sake of faith,\nto lose seventy-two loved ones\nbefore the afternoon?
